purpose: Provide an append-only, single-use authorisation and execution-admission control plane for on-demand Railway revalidation, including immutable native-Git candidate preparation before admission, without performing the external mutation itself.
invariants: A request never grants approval or execution authority.
An approval never executes Railway or any health probe.
An execution admission never executes Railway; it only creates a short-lived, exact-scope execution envelope.
Approval and execution admission are single-use and fingerprint-bound.
Any change in source head, serving/canonical identity, authority, target scope or sleep posture invalidates execution admission.
The external executor must verify the deployed commit equals the approved source head before health verification.
The external executor must not mark completion without health, attestation and release-admission reconciliation evidence.
No automatic wake, redeploy, retry, rollback or evidence rewrite is authorised by this database control plane.
Browser roles receive no table access or function EXECUTE grants.
A native-Git approval does not become executable until an immutable candidate commit is prepared and pinned.
Native-Git admission pins both the watched-branch base SHA and the candidate commit SHA.
The watched branch must still equal the pinned base SHA immediately before fast-forward execution.
